description: Recreates WorkSpaces under a new (Managed AD) directory after AD objects have been migrated. WorkSpaces cannot be moved across directories (migrate-workspace changes bundle/OS only, same directory), so each WorkSpace is recreated in the target directory. For each user, the SOURCE WorkSpace (in sourceDirectoryId) is READ to discover the bundle it currently uses, and the new WorkSpace is created with that same bundle (unless bundleIdOverride is set). This document is CREATE-ONLY: it reads the source WorkSpaces but NEVER terminates or modifies them. Decommissioning the old Simple AD WorkSpaces is a deliberate, manual, customer-owned step done after validation. This document does NOT copy user data. dryRun defaults to true.

targetDirectoryId.description: (Required) The Managed AD directory ID already registered with WorkSpaces (d-xxxxxxxxxx) that new WorkSpaces will be created in.

sourceDirectoryId.description: (Required) The SOURCE directory ID (d-xxxxxxxxxx) whose WorkSpaces are being migrated. Read-only: used to look up each user's existing WorkSpace and its bundle. This document never terminates or modifies anything in this directory.

userList.description: (Required) List of AD usernames (sAMAccountName) to recreate under the target directory. These must already exist in the target Managed AD. Batched 25 per create-workspaces call.

bundleIdOverride.description: (Optional) If set, use this bundle for ALL recreated WorkSpaces instead of inheriting each user's source bundle. Also used as the fallback bundle for users who have no source WorkSpace. Leave empty to inherit each user's source WorkSpace bundle per-user.

runningMode.description: (Optional) WorkSpace running mode for the recreated WorkSpaces.

dryRun.description: (Optional) If true, only report the plan (what would be created, with resolved per-user bundles) without calling create-workspaces.

autoRequestQuotaIncrease.description: (Optional) Default false. If the WorkSpaces service quota (L-34278094) in this region has too few free slots for this run, the QuotaCheck step ALWAYS fails closed and prints the exact 'aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase' command for an operator to run. A quota increase is asynchronous and approval-gated (it opens a support case), so it can NEVER be satisfied within this run. If this is set to true, the automation additionally FILES the increase request on your behalf (RequestServiceQuotaIncrease) and reports the CaseId, but still fails the run because the new limit will not be approved in time. This files a cost-impacting support case on the account, so it is off by default and must be explicitly opted into.

AutomationAssumeRole.description: (Optional) The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform actions on your behalf. Needs workspaces:DescribeWorkspaces/DescribeWorkspaceDirectories/CreateWorkspaces/DescribeTags and ds:DescribeDirectories, plus servicequotas:GetServiceQuota/GetAWSDefaultServiceQuota/ListRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryByQuota for the WorkSpaces quota preflight (and servicequotas:RequestServiceQuotaIncrease only if autoRequestQuotaIncrease=true). Does NOT need workspaces:TerminateWorkspaces (this document never terminates). Leave empty to run as the invoking identity.

mainSteps.name: Preconditions
mainSteps.description: Validate the target directory is registered with WorkSpaces and source != target.

mainSteps.name: BuildPlan
mainSteps.description: Read-only: resolve each user's SOURCE WorkSpace (scoped to sourceDirectoryId) and preserve its bundle AND properties (compute type, root/user volume sizes, volume encryption + KMS key, non-aws tags) so the recreated WorkSpace matches the source instead of silently dropping encryption and resizing to bundle defaults (#4). Bundle precedence: bundleIdOverride if set, else the user's single source bundle. Users with no source WorkSpace (and no override) are SKIPPED and reported; multiple differing source bundles are reported AMBIGUOUS and skipped; users already in the target are skipped (idempotency). When created from bundleIdOverride with no source WorkSpace, encryption/sizing fall back to bundle defaults and the plan flags encryption=bundle-default. Nothing is created or terminated here.

mainSteps.name: QuotaCheck
mainSteps.description: WorkSpaces service-quota preflight. Reads the applied WorkSpaces quota (L-34278094) in this region, counts the CURRENT region-wide WorkSpaces, and compares (current + toCreateCount) against the limit. The quota is REGION-WIDE (not per-directory), so a near-full region fails create-workspaces mid-batch and leaves a partial migration; this step fails closed BEFORE any create. On insufficient quota it prints the exact 'aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase' command and reports any already-pending increase request. A quota increase is asynchronous and approval-gated (opens a support case) so it can never be satisfied within this run. If autoRequestQuotaIncrease=true it also files the increase (RequestServiceQuotaIncrease) and reports the CaseId, but STILL fails the run. Read-only unless autoRequestQuotaIncrease=true. Does not count the per-bundle GraphicsPro/Graphics.g4dn sub-quotas (L-254B485B/L-BCACAEBC/L-BE9A8466), which have their own limits; flagged as a known limitation.

mainSteps.name: DryRunGate
mainSteps.description: If dryRun=true, stop at the plan. Otherwise proceed to create.

mainSteps.name: CreateWorkspaces
mainSteps.description: Create the recreated WorkSpaces in the target directory with each user's resolved bundle, batched 25 per call. Reports FailedRequests per user. Non-idempotent: not retried automatically to avoid duplicate WorkSpaces.

mainSteps.name: RecreateComplete
mainSteps.description: WorkSpaces recreate wave complete. The source (Simple AD) WorkSpaces are untouched; decommission them manually after validating the new WorkSpaces and copying off any user data.

mainSteps.name: PlanOnlyComplete
mainSteps.description: Dry run complete. Review BuildPlan output (resolved per-user bundles and any skipped users); re-run with dryRun=false to execute.
